Criterion A5, Owner Decisions OD-28 and OD-30.
Read from the SHIPPED PACK rather than from a list anybody typed: the pack is what reaches a
device, and a list is a document about a previous build. The Owner Decision is read too, and a
disagreement between them fails rather than silently following one.
TWO PLACES HOLD THAT PACK, and this field names the artifact rather than the path, on purpose.
dist/packs is the build output and is preferred; it cannot exist in CI, because building it
reads the canonical estate on the Owner machine. The app ships a committed copy of the same
artifact, and criterion E6 verifies that copy against the sha the contract names in the same
ladder run. Naming a path here would make this file report which machine generated it, and
that would read as drift on the other one.
source: the taxonomy pack — dist/packs/taxonomy/pack.json, or the app's committed copy of the same artifact when the estate is not reachable (E6 pins its sha either way)
